question_en: During lock-out/tag-out, what condition must be tested before servicing begins?
explanation_en: The RSOS performance criteria require testing for a zero-energy state during lock-out/tag-out.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige comprobar un estado de energía cero durante lock-out/tag-out.

question_en: A drawing shows the electrical isolation point, but the machine also stores pneumatic pressure. What should the electrician identify before declaring isolation complete?
explanation_en: The RSOS explicitly includes electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and other stored energy sources when identifying potential energy.
explanation_es: El RSOS incluye fuentes eléctricas, mecánicas, hidráulicas, neumáticas y otras energías almacenadas.

question_en: Which information should be used when evaluating maintenance test results for an overcurrent protection device?
options: Previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_en: RSOS B-8.02 requires evaluation against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-8.02 exige comparar con resultados previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: Which test is listed in the RSOS for maintenance of overcurrent protection devices?
explanation_en: Contact resistance is one of the tests listed for overcurrent protection device maintenance.
explanation_es: La resistencia de contacto es una de las pruebas listadas para mantenimiento de protección contra sobrecorriente.

question_en: After conducting scheduled tests on a protection device, what should be done with the results?
options: Discard them if the breaker operated.
Document them and evaluate them against references.
Use them only if a fault occurs later.
Replace the device regardless of result.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires documenting tests and evaluating results using previous results and specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige documentar las pruebas y evaluar los resultados contra referencias.

question_en: Which group contains only overcurrent protection devices listed in the RSOS?
explanation_en: The RSOS range of variables lists fuses, breakers and relay protection as overcurrent protection devices.
explanation_es: El RSOS lista fusibles, breakers y protección por relé como dispositivos de sobrecorriente.

question_en: A 600 V three-phase load draws 40 A at 0.90 power factor. Approximately what total real power is used?
explanation_en: Use P = E(line) × I(line) × PF × √3: about 37.4 kW.
explanation_es: Usa P = E(línea) × I(línea) × FP × √3: aproximadamente 37.4 kW.

question_en: A three-phase load is 75 kVA at 600 V. Approximately what line current is required?
explanation_en: Use I = VA / (E(line) × √3): about 72 A.
explanation_es: Usa I = VA / (E(línea) × √3): aproximadamente 72 A.
